23 On the mountain of the height of Israel I will plant it, and it will lift up branches and make fruit and become a majestic cedar; and under it will dwell every bird of every wing — in the shade of its branches they will dwell.
24 And all the trees of the field will know that I, Yahweh, have brought down the high tree, have raised up the low tree, have dried up the green tree and made the dry tree flourish. I, Yahweh, have spoken and have done it.

Ezekiel 18

1 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying:
2 What is it with you, that you use this proverb on the land of Israel, saying: The fathers eat sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?
3 As I live — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh — you will no longer have this proverb to use in Israel.
4 See, all lives are mine; as the life of the father, so also the life of the son is mine. The life that sins — it will die.
5 But if a man is righteous and does justice and righteousness,
6 and has not eaten on the mountains, and has not lifted his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, and has not defiled his neighbor's wife, and has not come near a woman in her impurity,
7 and has wronged no one, has returned the pledge to the debtor, has taken nothing by robbery, has given his bread to the hungry and covered the naked with a garment,
8 has not lent at interest and has not taken increase, has turned his hand back from iniquity, has done true justice between man and man,
9 has walked in my statutes and kept my ordinances, to do truth — he is righteous; he will surely live — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
10 And if he fathers a son who is violent, a shedder of blood, and does any one of these things,
11 while he himself did none of these things — for he has even eaten on the mountains and defiled his neighbor's wife,
12 has wronged the poor and needy, has committed robberies, has not returned the pledge, has lifted his eyes to the idols, has done an abomination,
13 has lent at interest and taken increase — will he live? He will not live. He has done all these abominations; he will surely be put to death; his blood will be on himself.
14 And see, if he fathers a son who sees all his father's sins that he did, and takes heed and does not do the like,
15 who has not eaten on the mountains, and has not lifted his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, has not defiled his neighbor's wife,
16 has wronged no one, has not taken a pledge, has not committed robbery, has given his bread to the hungry and covered the naked with a garment,
17 has turned his hand back from the poor, has not taken interest or increase, has done my ordinances, has walked in my statutes — he will not die for his father's iniquity; he will surely live.
18 His father — because he practiced oppression, robbed his brother of what he stole, and did what is not good among his people — see, he dies for his iniquity.
19 Yet you say: Why does the son not bear the father's iniquity? When the son has done justice and righteousness, has kept all my statutes and done them, he will surely live.
20 The life that sins — it will die. A son will not bear a father's iniquity, and a father will not bear a son's iniquity. The righteousness of the righteous will be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked will be on him.
21 But if the wicked man turns from all his sins that he committed, and keeps all my statutes and does justice and righteousness, he will surely live; he will not die.
22 All his transgressions that he committed will not be remembered against him; in his righteousness that he has done, he will live.
23 Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh — and not rather in his turning from his ways and living?
24 But when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and does iniquity — does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does — will he live? All his righteous deeds that he did will not be remembered; in his treachery that he committed and in his sin that he sinned, in them he will die.
25 Yet you say: The way of the Lord is not right. Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not right? Is it not your ways that are not right?
26 When a righteous man turns from his righteousness and does iniquity and dies in them, for his iniquity that he did he will die.
27 And when a wicked man turns from his wickedness that he committed and does justice and righteousness, he will keep his own life alive.
28 And he sees and turns back from all his transgressions that he committed; he will surely live; he will not die.
29 Yet the house of Israel says: The way of the Lord is not right. House of Israel, are my ways not right? Is it not your ways that are not right?
30 Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, each man according to his ways — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh. Turn back, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, and iniquity will not be a stumbling block to you.
31 Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed, and make yourselves a new heart and a new spirit; for why should you die, house of Israel?
32 For I have no pleasure in the death of the one who dies — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh. So turn back, and live.

Ezekiel 19

1 And you, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
2 and say: What was your mother? A lioness; among lions she lay down; in the midst of young lions she reared her cubs.
3 And she raised up one of her cubs; he became a young lion, and he learned to tear prey; he devoured men.
4 And the nations heard about him; he was caught in their pit, and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
5 And she saw that she had waited in vain, her hope was lost; and she took another of her cubs and made him a young lion.
6 And he walked about in the midst of the lions; he became a young lion, and he learned to tear prey; he devoured men.
7 And he knew their widows and laid waste their cities, and the land and its fullness were desolate at the sound of his roaring.
8 And the nations set themselves against him round about from the provinces, and spread their net over him; he was caught in their pit.
9 And they put him in a cage with hooks and brought him to the king of Babylon; they brought him into strongholds, so that his voice would no longer be heard on the mountains of Israel.
10 Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters; she was fruitful and full of branches from the many waters.
11 And she had strong rods for scepters of rulers, and her height rose up among the thick foliage, and she was seen in her height, in the multitude of her branches.
12 But she was uprooted in fury, thrown down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit; her strong rods were broken off and dried up; fire consumed her.
13 And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a land dry and thirsty.
14 And fire went out from the rod of her branches and devoured her fruit, and there was no strong rod in her, no scepter for ruling. This is a lamentation, and it has become a lamentation.

Ezekiel 20

1 And it happened in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, that men from the elders of Israel came to inquire of Yahweh and sat before me.
2 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying:
3 Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Have you come to inquire of me? As I live — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh — I will not be inquired of by you.
4 Will you judge them, son of man, will you judge them? Make known to them the abominations of their fathers,
5 and say to them: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: On the day I chose Israel, I lifted up my hand to the seed of the house of Jacob and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up my hand to them, saying: I am Yahweh your God.
6 On that day I lifted up my hand to them, to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands,
7 and I said to them: Each man cast away the detestable things of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.
8 But they rebelled against me and were not willing to listen to me; they did not cast away, each man, the detestable things of their eyes, and they did not forsake the idols of Egypt. And I said I would pour out my fury on them, to spend my anger on them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
9 But I acted for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations among whom they were, in whose eyes I made myself known to them, to bring them out of the land of Egypt.
10 And I brought them out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
11 And I gave them my statutes and made known to them my ordinances, which a man who does them will live by them.
12 And also my Sabbaths I gave them, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.
13 But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness; they did not walk in my statutes, and my ordinances they rejected, which a man who does them will live by them; and my Sabbaths they greatly profaned. And I said I would pour out my fury on them in the wilderness, to make an end of them.
14 But I acted for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations, in whose eyes I brought them out.
15 And I also lifted up my hand to them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land that I had given, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands,
16 because they rejected my ordinances and did not walk in my statutes and profaned my Sabbaths, for their heart went after their idols.
17 And my eye spared them, so as not to destroy them, and I did not make a full end of them in the wilderness.
18 And I said to their children in the wilderness: Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers, and do not keep their ordinances, and do not defile yourselves with their idols.
19 I am Yahweh your God; walk in my statutes and keep my ordinances and do them,
20 and make my Sabbaths holy, and they will be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.
21 But the children rebelled against me; they did not walk in my statutes, and my ordinances they did not keep, to do them, which a man who does them will live by them; they profaned my Sabbaths. And I said I would pour out my fury on them, to spend my anger on them in the wilderness.
22 But I turned back my hand and acted for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations, in whose eyes I brought them out.
23 I also lifted up my hand to them in the wilderness, to scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the lands,
24 because they did not do my ordinances and rejected my statutes and profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.
25 And I myself also gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances by which they could not live,
26 and I defiled them through their own gifts, when they made every one that opens the womb pass over, so that I might lay them waste, so that they might know that I am Yahweh.
27 Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel and say to them: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: In this too your fathers blasphemed me, in that they committed treachery against me.
28 And I brought them into the land that I lifted up my hand to give them, and they saw every high hill and every thick tree, and they sacrificed there their sacrifices, and they gave there the provocation of their offering, and they set there the scent of their soothing aromas, and they poured out there their drink offerings.
29 And I said to them: What is the high place to which you go? And its name is called Bamah to this day.
30 Therefore say to the house of Israel: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Do you defile yourselves in the way of your fathers, and do you whore after their detestable things,
31 and in lifting up your gifts, in making your sons pass through the fire, do you defile yourselves with all your idols to this day? And shall I be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh — I will not be inquired of by you,
32 and what comes up in your mind will certainly not be, in that you say: We will be like the nations, like the families of the lands, to serve wood and stone.
33 As I live — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh — surely with a strong hand and an outstretched arm and fury poured out I will be king over you,
34 and I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands in which you are scattered, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm and fury poured out,
35 and I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.
36 As I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
37 And I will make you pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant,
38 and I will purge out from you the rebels and those who transgress against me; from the land of their sojourning I will bring them out, but into the land of Israel they will not come; and you will know that I am Yahweh.
39 And you, house of Israel — thus says the Lord Yahweh: Go, each man serve his idols, and afterward too, if you will not listen to me; but my holy name you will no longer profane with your gifts and with your idols.
40 For on my holy mountain, on the mountain of the height of Israel — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh — there all the house of Israel, all of it, will serve me in the land; there I will accept them, and there I will seek your contributions and the firstfruits of your gifts, with all your holy things.
41 As a soothing aroma I will accept you, when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands in which you have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you in the eyes of the nations.
42 And you will know that I am Yahweh, when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the land that I lifted up my hand to give to your fathers.
43 And there you will remember your ways and all your deeds in which you defiled yourselves, and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you did.
44 And you will know that I am Yahweh, when I deal with you for my name's sake, not according to your evil ways and not according to your corrupt deeds, house of Israel — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.

Ezekiel 21

1 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying:
2 Son of man, set your face toward the south, and preach toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field, the Negev.
3 And say to the forest of the Negev: Hear the word of Yahweh. Thus says the Lord Yahweh: See, I am kindling a fire in you, and it will devour in you every green tree and every dry tree; the blazing flame will not be quenched, and all faces from the Negev to the north will be scorched by it.
4 And all flesh will see that I, Yahweh, have kindled it; it will not be quenched.
5 And I said: Ah, Lord Yahweh! They are saying of me: Is he not a maker of parables?
6 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying:
7 Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel,
8 and say to the land of Israel: Thus says Yahweh: See, I am against you, and I will draw my sword from its sheath and cut off from you righteous and wicked.
9 Because I will cut off from you righteous and wicked, therefore my sword will go out from its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north,
10 and all flesh will know that I, Yahweh, have drawn my sword from its sheath; it will not return again.
11 And you, son of man, groan; with breaking of loins and with bitterness groan before their eyes.
12 And it will be, when they say to you: Why are you groaning? — that you will say: Because of the report, for it is coming; and every heart will melt, and all hands will go limp, and every spirit will faint, and all knees will run with water. See, it is coming, and it will happen — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
13 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying:
14 Son of man, prophesy and say: Thus says the Lord: Say: A sword, a sword — it is sharpened, and also polished,
15 sharpened in order to slaughter a slaughter, polished that it may have a flash of lightning. Or shall we rejoice? The rod of my son despises every tree.
16 And he gave it to be polished, to be grasped in the hand; it is sharpened — the sword — and it is polished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
17 Cry out and wail, son of man, for it is against my people, it is against all the princes of Israel; they are thrown down to the sword with my people; therefore strike your thigh.
18 For it is a testing; and what if even the despising rod will be no more? — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
19 And you, son of man, prophesy and strike hand against hand, and let the sword be doubled a third time — the sword of the slain; it is the sword of the great slain one, which pierces into them.
20 That the heart may melt and stumblings multiply, I have set the flash of the sword against all their gates. Ah! It is made for lightning, wrapped for slaughter.
21 Gather yourself together, go to the right; set yourself, go to the left — wherever your face is appointed.
22 And I also will strike my hand against my hand, and I will lay my fury to rest. I, Yahweh, have spoken.
23 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying:
24 And you, son of man, set for yourself two ways for the sword of the king of Babylon to come; from one land both of them will come out; and carve a hand-sign; carve it at the head of the way to the city.
25 Set a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.
26 For the king of Babylon stands at the mother of the way, at the head of the two ways, to divine a divination; he shakes the arrows, he asks the teraphim, he looks in the liver.
27 In his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem: to set battering rams, to open the mouth in slaughter, to lift the voice in a war shout, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up a ramp, to build a siege wall.
28 And to them it will be like a false divination in their eyes — they have sworn oaths upon oaths — but he brings iniquity to remembrance, that they may be caught.
29 Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because you have brought your iniquity to remembrance, your transgressions being uncovered so that your sins appear in all your deeds; because you are remembered, you will be caught in the hand.
30 And you, slain wicked one, prince of Israel, whose day has come in the time of the iniquity of the end,
31 thus says the Lord Yahweh: Remove the turban and take off the crown; this shall not be this; what is low will be raised, and what is high will be brought low.
32 A ruin, a ruin, a ruin I will make it; this too will not be, until he comes whose is the judgment, and I will give it to him.
33 And you, son of man, prophesy and say: Thus says the Lord Yahweh to the children of Ammon and to their taunting: And say: A sword, a sword, drawn for slaughter, polished to consume, that it may flash like lightning,
34 while they see emptiness for you, while they divine lies for you, to set you on the necks of the slain of the wicked, whose day has come in the time of the iniquity of the end.
35 Return it to its sheath! In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin, I will judge you.
36 And I will pour out my indignation on you; with the fire of my wrath I will blow on you, and I will give you into the hand of brutal men, craftsmen of destruction.
37 You will be fuel for the fire; your blood will be in the midst of the land; you will not be remembered, for I, Yahweh, have spoken.

Ezekiel 22

1 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying:
2 And you, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the city of blood? Then make known to her all her abominations,
3 and say: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: A city shedding blood in her midst, that her time may come, and making idols against herself to defile herself,
4 by your blood that you shed you have become guilty, and by your idols that you made you are defiled; and you have brought your days near, and you have come to your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations and a mockery to all the lands.
5 Those near and those far from you will mock you, defiled of name, full of tumult.
6 See, the princes of Israel — each man by his own arm — have been in you for the shedding of blood.
7 Father and mother they have treated lightly in you; the sojourner they have dealt with by oppression in your midst; the fatherless and the widow they have wronged in you.
8 My holy things you have despised, and my Sabbaths you have profaned.
9 Men of slander have been in you for the shedding of blood, and on the mountains they have eaten in you; lewdness they have done in your midst.
10 A father's nakedness they have uncovered in you; a woman unclean in her impurity they have humbled in you.
11 And one man has done an abomination with his neighbor's wife, and one man has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law, and one man in you has humbled his sister, his father's daughter.
12 Bribes they have taken in you for the shedding of blood; interest and increase you have taken, and you have gained greedily from your neighbors by oppression, and me you have forgotten — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
13 And see, I have struck my hand against your dishonest gain that you made, and against your blood that was in your midst.
14 Can your heart stand, or can your hands be strong, in the days when I deal with you? I, Yahweh, have spoken and will do it.
15 And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you through the lands, and I will consume your uncleanness from you.
16 And you will be profaned in yourself in the eyes of the nations, and you will know that I am Yahweh.
17 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying:
18 Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me; all of them are bronze and tin and iron and lead in the midst of the furnace; they are dross of silver.
19 Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because all of you have become dross, therefore see, I am gathering you into the midst of Jerusalem.
20 As a gathering of silver and bronze and iron and lead and tin into the midst of a furnace, to blow fire on it, to melt it — so I will gather you in my anger and in my fury, and I will lay you down and melt you.
21 And I will assemble you and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in her midst.
22 As silver is melted in the midst of a furnace, so you will be melted in her midst, and you will know that I, Yahweh, have poured out my fury on you.
23 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying:
24 Son of man, say to her: You are a land that is not cleansed; she is not rained on in the day of indignation.
25 There is a conspiracy of her prophets in her midst, like a roaring lion tearing prey; they have devoured lives; treasure and precious things they take; her widows they have multiplied in her midst.
26 Her priests have done violence to my law and profaned my holy things; between holy and common they have not distinguished, and between the unclean and the clean they have not made known; and from my Sabbaths they have hidden their eyes, and I am profaned in their midst.
27 Her princes in her midst are like wolves tearing prey, to shed blood, to destroy lives, in order to gain dishonest gain.
28 And her prophets have smeared for them with whitewash, seeing emptiness and divining lies for them, saying: Thus says the Lord Yahweh — when Yahweh has not spoken.
29 The people of the land have practiced oppression and committed robbery, and the poor and needy they have wronged, and the sojourner they have oppressed without justice.
30 And I sought from them a man building a wall and standing in the breach before me on behalf of the land, so that I would not destroy it; and I found none.
31 And I poured out my indignation on them; with the fire of my wrath I made an end of them; their way I put on their head — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.

Ezekiel 23

1 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying:
2 Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother,
3 and they played the whore in Egypt; in their youth they played the whore. There their breasts were pressed, and there the nipples of their virginity were fondled.
4 And their names were Oholah the elder and Oholibah her sister; and they became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. And their names: Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.
5 And Oholah played the whore while she was under me, and she lusted after her lovers, after Assyria, her neighbors,
6 clothed in blue, governors and deputies, desirable young men all of them, horsemen riding horses.
7 And she gave her whorings to them, the choice men of Assyria, all of them; and with all those she lusted after, with all their idols, she defiled herself.
8 And her whorings from Egypt she did not leave, for with her they lay in her youth, and they fondled the nipples of her virginity, and poured out their whoring on her.
9 Therefore I gave her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the sons of Assyria, after whom she lusted.
10 They uncovered her nakedness; her sons and her daughters they took, and her they killed with the sword; and she became a name among women, and judgments they executed on her.
11 And her sister Oholibah saw, and she corrupted her lusting beyond hers, and her whorings beyond the whorings of her sister.
12 After the sons of Assyria she lusted — governors and deputies, her neighbors, clothed in splendor, horsemen riding horses, desirable young men all of them.
13 And I saw that she was defiled; one way belonged to both of them.
14 And she added to her whorings, and she saw men carved on the wall, images of the Chaldeans carved with red pigment,
15 girded with belts on their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them in the appearance of officers, the likeness of the sons of Babylon, Chaldeans, the land of their birth.
16 And she lusted after them at the sight of her eyes, and she sent messengers to them to Chaldea.
17 And the sons of Babylon came to her, to the bed of love, and defiled her with their whoring; and she was defiled by them, and her soul tore itself away from them.
18 And she uncovered her whorings and uncovered her nakedness, and my soul tore itself away from her, as my soul tore itself away from her sister.
19 And she multiplied her whorings, remembering the days of her youth, when she played the whore in the land of Egypt,
20 and she lusted after their paramours, whose flesh is the flesh of donkeys and whose discharge is the discharge of horses.
21 And you revisited the lewdness of your youth, when those from Egypt fondled your nipples for the sake of the breasts of your youth.
22 Therefore, Oholibah, thus says the Lord Yahweh: See, I am rousing your lovers against you, those from whom your soul tore itself away, and I will bring them against you from round about:
23 the sons of Babylon and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, all the sons of Assyria with them, desirable young men, governors and deputies all of them, officers and men of renown, all of them riding horses.
24 And they will come against you with weapons, chariots and wagons, and with a company of peoples; with large shield and shield and helmet they will set themselves against you round about; and I will give judgment before them, and they will judge you by their judgments.
25 And I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury; your nose and your ears they will remove, and your remnant will fall by the sword; they will take your sons and your daughters, and your remnant will be devoured by fire.
26 And they will strip you of your clothes and take the articles of your splendor.
27 And I will make your lewdness cease from you, and your whoring from the land of Egypt, and you will not lift your eyes to them, and Egypt you will remember no more.
28 For thus says the Lord Yahweh: See, I am giving you into the hand of those you hate, into the hand of those from whom your soul tore itself away,
29 and they will deal with you in hatred and take all your labor and leave you naked and bare, and the nakedness of your whorings will be uncovered — your lewdness and your whorings.
30 These things will be done to you, because you whored after the nations, because you were defiled with their idols.
31 In the way of your sister you walked, and I will give her cup into your hand.
32 Thus says the Lord Yahweh: The cup of your sister you will drink, the deep and the wide one; you will be for laughter and for mockery; it holds much.
33 With drunkenness and grief you will be filled — the cup of horror and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
34 And you will drink it and drain it, and its sherds you will gnaw, and your breasts you will tear out; for I have spoken — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
35 Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because you forgot me and cast me behind your back, you also bear your lewdness and your whorings.
36 And Yahweh said to me: Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
37 For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols they have committed adultery; and their sons, whom they bore to me, they have made pass over to them, to be devoured.
38 Moreover, this they have done to me: they defiled my sanctuary on that very day and profaned my Sabbaths.
39 And when they slaughtered their children to their idols, they came on that very day into my sanctuary to profane it; and see, so they did in the midst of my house.
40 And moreover, you sent for men coming from far away, to whom a messenger was sent, and see, they came — for whom you washed yourself, you painted your eyes, and you put on ornaments,
41 and you sat on a splendid bed, with a table arranged before it, and my incense and my oil you set on it.
42 And the sound of a carefree multitude was in her; and with the men, from the mass of mankind, drunkards were brought from the wilderness, and they put bracelets on their hands and a crown of splendor on their heads.
43 And I said of the one worn out with adulteries: Now they will play the whore with her whorings — and she too.
44 And they went in to her as one goes in to a whore-woman; so they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.
45 And righteous men — they will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood, for they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
46 For thus says the Lord Yahweh: Bring up a company against them, and give them over to horror and to plunder,
47 and the company will stone them with stones and cut them down with their swords; their sons and their daughters they will kill, and their houses they will burn with fire.
48 And I will make lewdness cease from the land, and all the women will be disciplined and will not do according to your lewdness.
49 And they will put your lewdness on you, and the sins of your idols you will bear, and you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.

Ezekiel 24

1 And the word of Yahweh came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, saying:
2 Son of man, write for yourself the name of the day, this very day; on this very day the king of Babylon has drawn up against Jerusalem.
3 And speak a parable to the rebellious house and say to them: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Set on the pot, set it on, and also pour water into it,
4 gather its pieces into it, every good piece, thigh and shoulder; fill it with the choice bones,
5 take the choice of the flock, and also heap the bones under it; make its boilings boil hard; let its bones too be cooked in its midst.
6 Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Woe to the city of blood, to the pot whose rust is in it and whose rust has not gone out of it! Take it out piece by piece; no lot has fallen on it.
7 For her blood was in her midst; on the bare surface of a rock she set it; she did not pour it on the ground, to cover it with dust,
8 so that fury might come up, to take vengeance, I set her blood on the bare surface of a rock, so that it would not be covered.
9 Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Woe to the city of blood! I also will make the fire-pile great,
10 heap on the wood, kindle the fire, cook the flesh thoroughly, and mix in the spiced broth, and let the bones be burned up,
11 and set it empty on its coals, so that it may get hot and its bronze burn, and its uncleanness be melted in its midst, and its rust be consumed.
12 It has wearied with toils, yet its great rust does not go out of it; in fire is its rust.
13 In your uncleanness is lewdness. Because I cleansed you and you were not cleansed, you will not be cleansed from your uncleanness again, until I have laid my fury to rest on you.
14 I, Yahweh, have spoken; it is coming, and I will do it. I will not hold back, and I will not spare, and I will not relent. According to your ways and according to your deeds they will judge you — the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
15 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying:
16 Son of man, see, I am taking from you the delight of your eyes with a plague; and you shall not mourn and you shall not weep, and your tears shall not come.
17 Groan in silence; make no mourning for the dead. Bind your turban on you and put your shoes on your feet, and do not cover over the lip, and do not eat the bread of men.
18 And I spoke to the people in the morning, and my wife died in the evening, and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
19 And the people said to me: Will you not tell us what these things mean for us, that you are doing?
20 And I said to them: The word of Yahweh came to me, saying:
21 Say to the house of Israel: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: See, I am profaning my sanctuary, the pride of your strength, the delight of your eyes and the pity of your soul; and your sons and your daughters whom you left behind will fall by the sword.
22 And you will do as I have done: you will not cover over the lip, and the bread of men you will not eat,
23 and your turbans will be on your heads and your shoes on your feet; you will not mourn and you will not weep, and you will rot away in your iniquities and groan, each man to his brother.
24 And Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When it comes, you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.
25 And you, son of man — will it not be on the day when I take from them their stronghold, the joy of their glory, the delight of their eyes and the lifting of their soul, their sons and their daughters,
26 that on that day the fugitive will come to you, to make it heard in your ears?
27 On that day your mouth will be opened with the fugitive, and you will speak and be dumb no longer, and you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am Yahweh.

Ezekiel 25

1 The word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
2 Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them,
3 and say to the children of Ammon: Hear the word of the Lord Yahweh. Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because you said, Aha! against my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity,
4 therefore, see, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession, and they will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you; they will eat your fruit, and they will drink your milk.
5 And I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels, and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks; and you will know that I am Yahweh.
6 For thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because you have clapped your hands and stamped with the foot, and rejoiced with all the disdain of your soul against the land of Israel,
7 therefore, see, I stretch out my hand on you, and will deliver you as plunder to the nations; and I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish from the countries; I will destroy you, and you will know that I am Yahweh.
8 Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because Moab and Seir say: See, the house of Judah is like all the nations,
9 therefore, see, I will open the flank of Moab from the cities, from his cities that are on his frontier, the glory of the land, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,
10 to the children of the east, against the children of Ammon, and I will give it for a possession, so that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations,
11 and I will execute judgments on Moab; and they will know that I am Yahweh.
12 Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because Edom has acted against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and taken revenge on them,
13 therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it, and I will make it desolate from Teman; and as far as Dedan they will fall by the sword.
14 And I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my fury, and they will know my vengeance, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
15 Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because the Philistines have acted in revenge, and have taken vengeance with disdain of soul, to destroy, out of ancient hostility,
16 therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: See, I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
17 And I will execute great vengeance on them with furious rebukes; and they will know that I am Yahweh, when I lay my vengeance on them.

Ezekiel 26

1 And it came to pass in the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, that the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
2 Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem: Aha! She is broken, she who was the gate of the peoples; she is turned to me; I will be filled, now that she is laid waste,
3 therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: See, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.
4 And they will destroy the walls of Tyre and break down her towers; and I will scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.
5 She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh; and she will become plunder for the nations.
6 And her daughters that are in the field will be slain with the sword; and they will know that I am Yahweh.
7 For thus says the Lord Yahweh: See, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses and with chariots and with horsemen, and a company and much people.
8 He will slay your daughters in the field with the sword, and he will set siege works against you, and pour out a siege mound against you, and raise a great shield against you.
9 And he will set the blow of his battering ram against your walls, and he will break down your towers with his axes.
10 From the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you; at the sound of horseman and wheel and chariot your walls will shake, when he enters your gates, as men enter a city that is breached.
11 With the hoofs of his horses he will trample all your streets; he will slay your people with the sword, and the pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.
12 And they will plunder your wealth and seize your merchandise as prey, and break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses; and they will lay your stones and your timber and your dust in the midst of the waters.
13 And I will cause the noise of your songs to cease, and the sound of your lyres will be heard no more.
14 And I will make you a bare rock; you will be a place for the spreading of nets; you will be built no more, for I, Yahweh, have spoken, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
15 Thus says the Lord Yahweh to Tyre: Will not the coastlands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when slaughter is made in your midst?
16 Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and take off their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments; they will clothe themselves with trembling; they will sit on the ground, and tremble every moment, and be appalled at you.
17 And they will take up a lamentation for you, and say to you: How you are destroyed, you who were peopled from the seas, the renowned city, that was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who set their terror on all its inhabitants!
18 Now the coastlands will tremble in the day of your fall, and the coastlands that are in the sea will be dismayed at your going out.
19 For thus says the Lord Yahweh: When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep on you, and the great waters cover you,
20 then I will bring you down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of old, and I will make you dwell in the lowest parts of the earth, in places desolate from of old, with those who go down to the pit, so that you are not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living,
21 I will make you a terror, and you will be no more; though you are sought for, you will never be found again, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.

Ezekiel 27

1 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
2 And you, son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyre,
3 and say to Tyre, who dwells at the entrances of the sea, the merchant of the peoples to many coastlands: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Tyre, you have said: I am perfect in beauty.
4 Your borders are in the heart of the seas; your builders have perfected your beauty.
5 They built all your planks of fir trees from Senir; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
6 They made your oars of oaks from Bashan; your deck they made of ivory inlaid in boxwood from the coastlands of Kittim.
7 Fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt was your sail, to be a banner for you; blue and purple from the coastlands of Elishah was your awning.
8 The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers; your wise men, Tyre, were in you — they were your pilots.
9 The elders of Gebal and its wise men were in you, repairing your seams; all the ships of the sea with their sailors were in you, to trade your merchandise.
10 Persia and Lud and Put were in your army, your men of war; they hung shield and helmet in you; they set forth your splendour.
11 The men of Arvad and your army were on your walls all around, and the Gammadim were in your towers; they hung their shields on your walls all around; they perfected your beauty.
12 Tarshish was your merchant because of the abundance of all wealth; with silver, iron, tin, and lead they traded for your wares.
13 Javan, Tubal, and Meshech — they were your traders; with the lives of men and vessels of bronze they traded for your merchandise.
14 From the house of Togarmah they traded for your wares with horses and horsemen and mules.
15 The men of Dedan were your traders; many coastlands were the market of your hand; horns of ivory and ebony they brought back as your tribute.
16 Aram was your merchant because of the abundance of your works; with carbuncle, purple, and embroidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and ruby they traded for your wares.
17 Judah and the land of Israel — they were your traders; with wheat of Minnith, and pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm they traded for your merchandise.
18 Damascus was your merchant for the abundance of your works, because of the abundance of all wealth, with the wine of Helbon and white wool.
19 Vedan and Javan from Uzal traded in your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were in your merchandise.
20 Dedan was your trader in cloths of distinction for riding.
21 Arabia and all the princes of Kedar — they were the merchants of your hand; in lambs, and rams, and goats, in these they were your merchants.
22 The traders of Sheba and Raamah — they were your traders; with the best of all spices, and with every precious stone, and gold, they traded for your wares.
23 Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad were your traders.
24 They were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords and made of cedar, among your merchandise.
25 The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise; and you were filled and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.
26 Into great waters your rowers brought you; the east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.
27 Your wealth and your wares, your merchandise, your sailors and your pilots, your seam-repairers and the traders of your merchandise, and all your men of war who are in you, and all your company that is in your midst, will fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your fall.
28 At the sound of the cry of your pilots, the pasture lands will shake.
29 And all who handle the oar will come down from their ships, the sailors and all the pilots of the sea; they will stand on the land,
30 and will make their voice heard over you, and cry bitterly, and cast up dust on their heads, and wallow in the ashes,
31 and make themselves bald for you, and gird themselves with sackcloth, and weep for you in bitterness of soul, with bitter mourning.
32 And in their wailing they will take up a lamentation for you, and lament over you: Who is like Tyre, like one silenced in the midst of the sea?
33 When your wares went out from the seas, you satisfied many peoples; with the abundance of your wealth and your merchandise you enriched the kings of the earth.
34 At the time you are broken from the seas, in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company have fallen in your midst.
35 All the inhabitants of the coastlands are appalled at you, and their kings shudder greatly; their faces are troubled.
36 The merchants among the peoples hiss at you; you have become a terror, and you will be no more, forever.

Ezekiel 28

1 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
2 Son of man, say to the prince of Tyre: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said: I am a god; I sit in the seat of God, in the heart of the seas — yet you are man, and not God, though you set your heart as the heart of God —
3 see, you are wiser than Daniel; no secret is hidden from you.
4 By your wisdom and by your understanding you have made wealth for yourself, and have made gold and silver in your treasuries,
5 by your great wisdom, in your trading, you have increased your wealth, and your heart is lifted up because of your wealth —
6 therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because you have set your heart as the heart of God,
7 therefore, see, I will bring strangers on you, the ruthless of the nations, and they will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom, and defile your splendour.
8 They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die the deaths of the slain in the heart of the seas.
9 Will you indeed say before your slayer: I am God? But you are man, and not God, in the hand of those who pierce you.
10 You will die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers, for I have spoken, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
11 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
12 Son of man, take up a lamentation for the king of Tyre, and say to him: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: You were the seal of the pattern, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty,
13 you were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone was your covering: carnelian, topaz, and emerald, beryl, onyx, and jasper, sapphire, carbuncle, and emerald, and gold; the workmanship of your settings and your sockets was in you; on the day you were created they were prepared.
14 You were the anointed covering cherub, and I set you; you were on the holy mountain of God; you walked in the midst of the stones of fire.
15 You were perfect in your ways from the day you were created, until unrighteousness was found in you.
16 By the abundance of your trading, your midst was filled with violence, and you sinned; and I cast you as profane from the mountain of God, and I destroyed you, covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
17 Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom for the sake of your splendour; I cast you to the ground; I set you before kings, that they may gaze on you.
18 By the abundance of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your trading, you profaned your sanctuaries; and I brought out fire from your midst — it devoured you — and I made you ashes on the earth in the eyes of all who see you.
19 All who know you among the peoples are appalled at you; you have become a terror, and you will be no more, forever.
20 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
21 Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,
22 and say: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: See, I am against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in your midst; and they will know that I am Yahweh, when I execute judgments in her and am shown holy in her.
23 And I will send pestilence into her, and blood in her streets, and the slain will fall in her midst, by the sword on her from every side; and they will know that I am Yahweh.
24 And there will no longer be for the house of Israel a pricking brier or a painful thorn from all who are around them, who scorn them; and they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.
25 Thus says the Lord Yahweh: When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they were scattered, and am shown holy in them in the sight of the nations, then they will dwell on their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob,
26 and they will dwell on it in safety, and build houses and plant vineyards; yes, they will dwell in safety, when I execute judgments on all who scorn them from around them; and they will know that I am Yahweh their God.

Ezekiel 29

1 In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
2 Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt,
3 speak, and say: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: See, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lies in the midst of his rivers, who has said: My river is my own, and I have made it for myself.
4 And I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will make the fish of your rivers stick to your scales, and I will bring you up out of the midst of your rivers, and all the fish of your rivers will stick to your scales.
5 And I will leave you in the wilderness, you and all the fish of your rivers; you will fall on the open field; you will not be gathered up, nor collected; to the beast of the earth and to the bird of the sky I have given you for food.
6 And all the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am Yahweh, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
7 When they grasp you in the palm, you snap, and tear open for them every shoulder; and when they lean on you, you break, and make all their loins stand still.
8 Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: See, I will bring a sword on you, and will cut off man and beast from you.
9 And the land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste, and they will know that I am Yahweh, because he has said: The river is mine, and I have made it.
10 Therefore, see, I am against you, and against your rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt wastes of waste, a desolation, from Migdol to Syene, as far as the border of Cush.
11 No foot of man will pass through it, and no foot of beast will pass through it, and it will not be inhabited for forty years.
12 And I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of desolated countries, and her cities in the midst of cities laid waste will be a desolation forty years; and I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and disperse them through the countries.
13 For thus says the Lord Yahweh: At the end of forty years I will gather Egypt from the peoples where they were scattered,
14 and I will restore the fortunes of Egypt, and bring them back to the land of Pathros, to the land of their origin, and they will be there a lowly kingdom.
15 It will be the lowliest of the kingdoms, and it will not lift itself up above the nations again; and I will make them few, so that they do not rule over the nations.
16 And it will no longer be for the house of Israel a confidence that brings iniquity to remembrance, when they turn after them; and they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.
17 And it came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, that the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
18 Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made his army serve a great service against Tyre; every head was made bald, and every shoulder rubbed bare; yet there was no wages for him or for his army from Tyre, for the service that he served against it,
19 therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: See, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he will carry off her multitude, and plunder her plunder, and prey on her prey, and it will be wages for his army.
20 As his payment for what he served, I have given him the land of Egypt, because they worked for me, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
21 In that day I will make a horn sprout for the house of Israel, and I will give you an opening of the mouth in their midst; and they will know that I am Yahweh.

Ezekiel 30

1 And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
2 Son of man, prophesy, and say: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Wail: Alas for the day!
3 For the day is near, and the day of Yahweh is near; a day of clouds; it will be a time of the nations.
4 And a sword will come on Egypt, and anguish will be in Cush, when the slain fall in Egypt, and they take away her multitude, and her foundations are broken down.
5 Cush and Put and Lud, and all the mixed crowd, and Cub, and the sons of the land of the covenant, will fall with them by the sword.
6 Thus says Yahweh: And those who support Egypt will fall, and the pride of her power will come down; from Migdol to Syene they will fall in her by the sword, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
7 And they will be desolate in the midst of desolated countries, and her cities will be in the midst of cities laid waste.
8 And they will know that I am Yahweh, when I set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are broken.
9 In that day messengers will go out from before me in ships, to terrify Cush at ease; and anguish will be on them in the day of Egypt, for see, it is coming.
10 Thus says the Lord Yahweh: I will make the multitude of Egypt cease, by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.
11 He and his people with him, the ruthless of the nations, are brought to destroy the land; and they will draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
12 And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of evil men, and I will make the land and its fullness desolate by the hand of strangers; I, Yahweh, have spoken.
13 Thus says the Lord Yahweh: I will destroy idols, and make the worthless gods cease from Memphis, and there will be no prince from the land of Egypt again; and I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
14 And I will make Pathros desolate, and set a fire in Zoan, and execute judgments in No,
15 and I will pour out my fury on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt, and cut off the multitude of No.
16 And I will set a fire in Egypt; Sin will writhe in anguish, and No will be broken open, and Memphis — adversaries by day.
17 The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth will fall by the sword, and they will go into captivity.
18 And at Tehaphnehes the day will be dark, when I break there the yokes of Egypt, and the pride of her power will cease in her; as for her, a cloud will cover her, and her daughters will go into captivity.
19 And I will execute judgments in Egypt; and they will know that I am Yahweh.
20 And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh day of the month, that the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
21 Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and see, it has not been bound up, to give healing, to put a bandage, to bind it up to make it strong, to grasp the sword.
22 Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: See, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and I will break his arms, the strong one and the broken one, and I will make the sword fall from his hand.
23 And I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and disperse them through the countries.
24 And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand, and I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him the groans of a mortally wounded man.
25 And I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh will fall, and they will know that I am Yahweh, when I put my sword in the hand of the king of Babylon, and he stretches it out against the land of Egypt.
26 And I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and disperse them through the countries; and they will know that I am Yahweh.

Ezekiel 31

1 And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first day of the month, that the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
2 Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude: To whom are you like in your greatness?
3 See, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon, beautiful of branch, and a shading forest, and high of stature, and its top was among the thick boughs.
4 The waters made it grow; the deep made it high, with its rivers going around its planting, and it sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.
5 Therefore its height was greater than all the trees of the field, and its boughs multiplied, and its branches grew long, from the abundance of waters, in its sending forth.
6 In its boughs all the birds of the sky nested, and under its branches all the beasts of the field gave birth, and in its shade all great nations dwelt.
7 And it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches, for its root was by abundant waters.
8 Cedars in the garden of God did not equal it; fir trees were not like its boughs, and plane trees were not like its branches; no tree in the garden of God was like it in its beauty.
9 I made it beautiful with the abundance of its branches, and all the trees of Eden that were in the garden of God envied it.
10 Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because it grew high in stature, and set its top among the thick boughs, and its heart was lifted up in its height,
11 I will give it into the hand of the mighty one of the nations; he will surely deal with it; for its wickedness I have driven it out.
12 And strangers, the ruthless of the nations, cut it off and left it; on the mountains and in all the valleys its branches fell, and its boughs were broken in all the watercourses of the land; and all the peoples of the earth went down from its shade and left it.
13 On its fallen trunk all the birds of the sky will dwell, and on its branches will be all the beasts of the field,
14 so that no trees by the waters may grow high in their stature, or set their top among the thick boughs, or stand in their height — none of their mighty ones, all who drink water; for they are all given to death, to the lowest parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with those who go down to the pit.
15 Thus says the Lord Yahweh: On the day it went down to Sheol, I caused mourning; I covered the deep over it, and I restrained its rivers, and the great waters were held back; and I made Lebanon black with mourning for it, and all the trees of the field fainted over it.
16 At the sound of its fall I made nations shake, when I brought it down to Sheol with those who go down to the pit; and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all who drink water, were comforted in the lowest parts of the earth.
17 They also went down with it to Sheol, to those slain by the sword, and those who were its arm, who dwelt in its shade in the midst of the nations.
18 To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lowest parts of the earth; in the midst of the uncircumcised you will lie, with those slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.

Ezekiel 32

1 And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first day of the month, that the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
2 Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say to him: You were like a young lion among the nations, and you are like the dragon in the seas; and you burst forth in your rivers, and muddied the waters with your feet, and fouled their rivers.
3 Thus says the Lord Yahweh: I will spread my net over you in a company of many peoples, and they will bring you up in my net.
4 And I will leave you on the land; on the open field I will hurl you, and I will make all the birds of the sky settle on you, and satisfy the beasts of the whole earth with you.
5 And I will lay your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.
6 And I will water the land of your swimming with your blood, as far as the mountains, and the watercourses will be filled with you.
7 And when you are extinguished, I will cover the sky and make its stars dark; the sun I will cover with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.
8 All the bright lights in the sky I will make dark over you, and I will set darkness on your land, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
9 And I will trouble the heart of many peoples, when I bring your destruction among the nations, to lands that you have not known.
10 And I will make many peoples appalled at you, and their kings will shudder at you with shuddering, when I brandish my sword before their faces; and they will tremble every moment, each man for his own life, in the day of your fall.
11 For thus says the Lord Yahweh: The sword of the king of Babylon will come on you.
12 By the swords of the mighty I will make your multitude fall; they are all the ruthless of the nations; and they will lay waste the pride of Egypt, and all her multitude will be destroyed.
13 And I will destroy all her beasts from beside abundant waters, and the foot of man will not muddy them again, and the hoofs of beasts will not muddy them.
14 Then I will make their waters settle clear, and make their rivers run like oil, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
15 When I make the land of Egypt a desolation, and the land is desolated of its fullness, when I strike all who dwell in it, then they will know that I am Yahweh.
16 This is the lamentation, and they will lament it; the daughters of the nations will lament it; over Egypt and over all her multitude they will lament it, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
17 And it came to pass in the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
18 Son of man, wail over the multitude of Egypt, and bring it down, her and the daughters of mighty nations, to the lowest parts of the earth, with those who go down to the pit.
19 Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.
20 In the midst of those slain by the sword they will fall; she is given to the sword; drag her away, and all her multitudes.
21 The mighty among the strong will speak to him out of the midst of Sheol, with his helpers; they have gone down, they lie, the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.
22 There is Asshur and all her company; around her are her graves; all of them slain, fallen by the sword,
23 whose graves are set in the farthest parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who gave terror in the land of the living.
24 There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who went down uncircumcised to the lowest parts of the earth, who set their terror in the land of the living, and they bore their shame with those who go down to the pit.
25 In the midst of the slain they set a bed for her, with all her multitude; her graves are around her; all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, for their terror was set in the land of the living, and they bore their shame with those who go down to the pit; he is set in the midst of the slain.
26 There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude; her graves are around her; all of them uncircumcised, pierced by the sword, for they set their terror in the land of the living.
27 And they will not lie with the mighty, the fallen of the uncircumcised, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, and laid their swords under their heads, and their iniquities are on their bones; for the terror of the mighty was in the land of the living.
28 And you, in the midst of the uncircumcised you will be broken and lie, with those slain by the sword.
29 There is Edom, her kings and all her princes, who in their might are laid with those slain by the sword; they will lie with the uncircumcised, and with those who go down to the pit.
30 There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who went down with the slain, in their terror, ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.
31 Pharaoh will see them, and will be comforted over all his multitude — Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
32 For I have set my terror in the land of the living, and he will be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, Pharaoh and all his multitude, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.

Ezekiel 33

1 Yahweh's word came to me, saying,
2 Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman,
3 if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people,
4 then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and doesn't heed the warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.
5 He heard the sound of the trumpet and didn't take warning. His blood will be on him; whereas if he had heeded the warning, he would have delivered his soul.
6 But if the watchman sees the sword come and doesn't blow the trumpet, and the people aren't warned, and the sword comes and takes any person from among them, he is taken away in his sin, but his blood I will require at the watchman's hand.
7 So you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and give them warnings from me.
8 When I tell the wicked, O wicked man, you will surely die, and you don't speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his sin, but I will require his blood at your hand.
9 Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn't turn from his way; he will die in his sin, but you have delivered your soul.
10 You, son of man, tell the house of Israel: You say this, Our transgressions and our sins are on us, and we pine away in them. How then can we live?
11 Tell them: As I live, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?
12 You, son of man, tell the children of your people, The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day of his disobedience. And as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not fall by it in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither will he who is righteous be able to live by it in the day that he sins.
13 When I tell the righteous that he will surely live, if he trusts in his righteousness and commits sin, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; but he will die in his sin that he has committed.
14 Again, when I say to the wicked, You will surely die, if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right,
15 if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no sin, he will surely live. He will not die.
16 None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.
17 Yet the children of your people say, The way of the Lord is not fair; but as for them, their way is not fair.
18 When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits sin, he will die in them.
19 When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.
20 Yet you say, The way of the Lord is not fair. House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.
21 And it happened in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, on the fifth day of the month, that a fugitive from Jerusalem came to me, saying: The city has been struck.
22 Now Yahweh's hand had been on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.
23 Yahweh's word came to me, saying,
24 Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.
25 Therefore tell them, The Lord Yahweh says: You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. And should you possess the land?
26 You stand on your sword, you work a detestable thing, and every one of you defiles his neighbor's wife. So should you possess the land?
27 Tell them this, The Lord Yahweh says: As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword, and whoever is in the open field I will give to the wild animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence.
28 I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment. The pride of her power will cease. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, so that no one will pass through.
29 Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their detestable things which they have committed.
30 As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to one another, everyone to his brother, saying, Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from Yahweh.
31 They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don't do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.
32 And see, you are to them as a love song, one who has a pleasant voice and plays well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they do not do them.
33 When this comes to pass—see, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.

Ezekiel 34

1 Yahweh's word came to me, saying,
2 Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, The Lord Yahweh says: Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Shouldn't the shepherds feed the sheep?
3 You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don't feed the sheep.
4 The weak you have not strengthened, and the sick you have not healed, and the broken you have not bound up, and the strayed you have not brought back, and the lost you have not sought; but with force and with harshness you have ruled them.
5 They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.
6 My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth. There was no one who searched or sought.
7 Therefore, you shepherds, hear Yahweh's word:
8 As I live, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh, surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds didn't search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn't feed my sheep,
9 therefore, you shepherds, hear Yahweh's word!
10 The Lord Yahweh says: See, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won't feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.
11 For the Lord Yahweh says: See, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
12 As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
13 I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
14 I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
15 I myself will shepherd my sheep, and I myself will make them lie down, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
16 I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.
17 As for you, O my flock, the Lord Yahweh says: See, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.
18 Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet?
19 As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.
20 Therefore the Lord Yahweh says to them: See, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
21 Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad,
22 therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep.
23 I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd.
24 I, Yahweh, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.
25 I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.
26 I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.
27 The tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the earth will yield its increase, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.
28 They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.
29 And I will raise up for them a planting of renown, and they will no longer be swept away by famine in the land, and they will bear the disgrace of the nations no longer.
30 They will know that I, Yahweh their God, am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
31 And you are my sheep, the sheep of my pasture; you are men, and I am your God, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.

Ezekiel 35

1 Moreover Yahweh's word came to me, saying,
2 Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
3 and tell it, The Lord Yahweh says: See, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.
4 I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
5 Because you have held an everlasting enmity, and have given the children of Israel over to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end,
6 therefore, as I live, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh, I will give you over to blood, and blood will pursue you. Since you did not hate blood, blood will pursue you.
7 Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.
8 I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.
9 I will make you perpetual desolations, and your cities will not be inhabited again; and you will know that I am Yahweh.
10 Because you have said, These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it, although Yahweh was there,
11 therefore, as I live, the declaration of the Lord Yahweh, I will do according to your anger and according to your envy that you showed out of your hatred against them, and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.
12 You will know that I, Yahweh, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.
13 You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.
14 The Lord Yahweh says: When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
15 As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.

Ezekiel 36

1 You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, You mountains of Israel, hear Yahweh's word.
2 The Lord Yahweh says: Because the enemy has said against you, Aha! and, The ancient high places are ours in possession!
3 Therefore prophesy, and say, The Lord Yahweh says: Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;
4 therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh: The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;
5 therefore the Lord Yahweh says: Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.
6 Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, The Lord Yahweh says: See, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.
